FuegeEilmeldungHinzu(Eilmeldung)

Inserts an emergency announcement directly before the currently planned contribution (i.e. at the front of the schedule).

FuegeEilmeldungMittenImProgrammHinzu(Eilmeldung, int)

Optional advanced: inserts the emergency announcement at the current running position. The currently playing contribution is split into two parts:

  • the first part (up to the announcement's start) stays in the schedule
  • the remaining rest is added as a NEW contribution right after the announcement.
